articles.summary: BOULDER, Colorado—October 14, 2021 — OnKure, Inc., a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company discovering and developing the next generation of oncology precision medicines, today announced the appointment of Jennifer R. Diamond, M.D., as Chief Medical Officer. Dr. Diamond, a trained oncologist, brings over 10 years of extensive clinical expertise in early phase trials and translational oncology research.Read More
articles.title: OnKure Therapeutics Appoints Jennifer R. Diamond, M.D., as Chief Medical Officer
